# outputs/ - GENERATED files only

Nothing in here is source or evidence. Everything is produced by `python -m cffc run` and can be
deleted and regenerated at any time.

- `outputs/synthetic/` - produced from `data/synthetic` (TEST DATA). Every table, figure and metrics
  JSON is stamped "SYNTHETIC TEST DATA - NOT AWS EVIDENCE - NOT RESEARCH RESULTS". These numbers
  exercise the code; they are not findings and must never be cited in the paper.
- `outputs/real/` - produced from `data/real` (real AWS evidence). Does not exist until real evidence
  has been collected, manifest-hashed and its ground truth frozen.
